translation.meaning: Use the library algebraMap from Polynomial Q into RatFunc Q; q is the image of Polynomial.X, not a numerical value.
Finset.range m indexes 0,...,m-1; exponent i+1 gives exactly the factors 1-q^1,...,1-q^m. For m=0 the product is empty.

Use the supervisor's T-product presentation of the standard Gaussian binomial, retaining the source's out-of-range zero branch. The n-k subtraction is confined to the k<=n branch. Correspondence with the source q-factorial formula is an audit obligation, not an assumed identity.
Use actual Polynomial.coeff on a rational polynomial at every natural degree; a natural-number witness requires both integral and non-negative coefficients.

Quantify all n,k,l and all rational polynomials H. The nonzero denominator and exact equality in RatFunc Q express defined quotient polynomiality. Neither integrality nor positivity of H is a premise. No reduced-range normalization is performed.

unresolved_ambiguities.observation: In both retrieved PDF text and HTML for 2603.22226v1 equation (2), the partition frame uses n-l and the first denominator product has 1-q^l despite indexing by i. Nearby prose instead gives a k by (n-k) frame. These are apparent source indexing errors, not silently copied into B.
unresolved_ambiguities.candidate_treatment: Use the standard definition explicitly given in 2502.06032v3 and the supplied supervisor T-product specification; independent semantic audit must confirm this interpretation.

unresolved_ambiguities.observation: Both conjectures quantify non-negative indices without an explicit nonzero-denominator clause, while the older source defines out-of-range binomials as zero. Their cancelled factorial displays also do not literally cover arbitrary out-of-range indices.
unresolved_ambiguities.candidate_treatment: Retain all indices, the standard zero numerator convention, and require B(n,l)!=0 as in the supervisor transcription. Audit this explicit rendering of a defined mathematical quotient; no replacement index restriction is imposed.

unresolved_ambiguities.observation: 2603.22226v1 explicitly includes integer coefficients; 2502.06032v3 Conjecture 1 says non-negative coefficients.
unresolved_ambiguities.candidate_treatment: Keep the integer conclusion of the selected 2603.22226v1 target. No equivalence theorem between the two phrasings is supplied or assumed.

unresolved_ambiguities.observation: The conjecture sentences say polynomial in q without specifying its coefficient field there.
unresolved_ambiguities.candidate_treatment: Use arbitrary H in Q[X], as specified by the supervisor. Audit this representation of polynomiality of a rational function over Q without inserting an integrality premise.

unresolved_ambiguities.observation: The retrieved 2603.22226v1 HTML displays Date: August 24, 2026; the versioned PDF text displays Date: March 24, 2026. The abstract submission history identifies v1 as March 23, 2026.
